recent_excerpts: Unit 42 ties Iran-nexus CL-STA-1178 to Blinder Tunnel, which hit Iraqi critical infrastructure in March 2026 using fake Dubai Airports lures and GitHub-hosted C2.
Kaspersky found ValleyRAT delivered via fake adware installer that disables Defender and sideloads libcef.dll. Targets Chinese-speaking users.
A new PlugX USB worm variant uses DLL sideloading to propagate across Asia and Africa, targeting removable drives for initial access and establishing persistence.
